# RAAR Lifestyle

> A tailored luxury lifestyle & events management atelier based in Dubai, operating worldwide.

RAAR orchestrates bespoke concierge and events services for a discerning international clientele. Every request is handled privately, carefully, and at pace.

## Services

- Hotels & Travel — private jets, storied resorts, end-to-end itineraries
- Real Estate — villas, riads, pieds-à-terre (Paris, South of France, Marrakech, Dubai)
- Dining & Reservations — chef's tables, private rooms, hard-to-book tables
- Wellness — retreats, interior design, considered living
- Health — in-home medical visits, IV therapy, on-call doctors and physios
- Luxury & Fashion — personal shopping, fine jewellery, timepieces, rare artworks
- Art — advisory, private viewings, gallery and fair access
- Beauty — make-up artists, aesthetic doctors, at-home glamour
- Staffing — nannies, chefs, chauffeurs, housekeepers, security
- Polo & Racing — Dubai equestrian days (Meydan, Al Habtoor)

## Founder

Asmaa Hanine — Founder & CEO. Graduate of a top-five Paris business school in International Marketing & Business Development; formerly consulted at Ernst & Young and Capgemini.

## Locations

Headquartered in Dubai. Active across Marrakech, Paris, and worldwide.
